name: Doba
summary: Dropshipping marketplace that connects online sellers with wholesale suppliers, with one-click listing to Shopify, eBay, Amazon, TikTok Shop and other channels, inventory lists and AI listing tools.
best_for: online sellers on Shopify, eBay, Amazon, TikTok Shop and similar channels who want to dropship from one wholesale catalogue and push listings into several stores, starting from the Basic tier
skip_if: you want to hold your own stock or build a private-label brand; or you need a clear refund promise before you pay, because the help centre and the terms say different things
honest_knock: The subscription only buys access: product costs, shipping, handling and transaction charges come on top of every order. Limited is too small to run a store on (20 inventory places, no monthly downloads), and Doba's refund terms contradict each other, from a 72-hour full refund in the help centre to 'all fees are non-refundable' in the terms.

pricing.notes: (read 2026-10-22 on doba.com/pricing with the Monthly, Quarterly and Annually toggles; prices in USD) Doba sells four subscription tiers. Billed monthly, Limited is $29.99 a month, Basic $59.99, Standard $149.99 and Enterprise $299.99. Quarterly billing takes 5% off (Limited $28.67, Basic $57.00, Standard $142.67 a month) and annual billing 15% (Limited $25.50, Basic $51.00, Standard $127.50 a month); Enterprise is sold monthly or annually only. Basic has a 7-day trial and Standard a 5-day trial, each for US$0.99. The fees policy says the full fee of the chosen tier is charged automatically when the trial ends, and the terms limit trials to first-time users. The subscription is not the whole bill: the fees policy says product costs, shipping, drop or order handling fees and transaction charges are paid separately at the time of purchase. Paid add-ons such as the AI Store Builder renew on their own cycle. On refunds Doba's own pages disagree: the help centre says a full refund is issued automatically if you cancel within 72 hours of payment, the fees policy excludes trial subscriptions, and the terms say all fees, including subscription fees, are non-refundable.

compare_with.name: Spocket
compare_with.why: Spocket is in our dossiers too and sells the same kind of supplier catalogue: when we read it on 1 October 2026 its Starter plan was $39.99 a month for 25 products. Doba's Limited is cheaper at $29.99 a month but caps the inventory list at 20 products and lists no monthly downloads, so the fair comparison is Doba Basic at $59.99. Compare the supplier range for your niche and the shipping times, not only the plan price.

exit_test.what: Daan created the account and our AI assistant ran the test in Daan's browser. On 19 November 2026 the session tested Doba on a retailer account Daan created, with no plan and the free Doba Pilot credits. Without a plan the catalogue shows stock and processing time but hides every price, and Add to Inventory List opens a $0.99 trial that renews at US$170.99 a quarter after 7 days. The free Pilot, asked for yoga mats with supplier price, shipping and delivery time, returned three products with prices, shipping rates, stock and landed costs for 1 credit in under 2 minutes. Pilot could not put a product on the inventory list and said such a list does not exist, while the catalogue does have one behind the trial. Account and start: Daan created a retailer account with No Plan and the free Doba Pilot (30 credits, US$ 0, no automatic renewal); our AI assistant ran the test in Daan's browser, in its own tabs, on 19 November 2026 from about 09:45 to 09:59 CET. The interface was in English. The cookie banner was answered with Reject Sharing. The address /retailer/dashboard gave a 404 page, but the header showed the signed-in account and the catalogue opened normally. The dossier name is Doba and the review is on MSS (mss/doba-review.html). Core action, find a product with supplier price, shipping, delivery time and stock: in the web catalogue without a plan, a search for yoga mat gave 144 results with ** in Stock and 2 Business Day(s), but every price read Subscribe to See Price. The product page of Jute Premium Eco Yoga Mat (Sport Pulse) said Subscribe to See Price, Subscribe to See Inventory and Subscribe to See Warehouse, Shipping N/A to Netherlands (US shipping only) and Processing Time 2 business days estimated, 1.2 average. Add to Inventory List opened the window Start Your $0.99 Trial Now at once. Doba Pilot (ai.doba.com), without a card, showed 30 credits left at 1 credit per message. The first question at about 09:50, find yoga mats with supplier price, shipping cost and delivery time, was answered in about 1 minute 45 seconds for 1 credit, with the prices the catalogue hid: Printed PVC Yoga Mat US$ 14.72 (stock 600, total landed cost $40.72 at 3 lb), 2 Tone TPE Premium Yoga Mat US$ 29.46 (stock 475, landed $44.46, MAP $48.96) and Jute Premium Eco Yoga Mat US$ 33.67 (stock 126, landed $70.67), UPS from US$ 13.00 and USPS from US$ 4.00, delivery in 3 to 5 days, shipping not free, and the supplier figures Open 4.4 years, Fulfillment Rate 88.89% and Refund Rate 11.11%. The text named the supplier Maji Sports while the cards showed Sport Pulse. The result panel also showed Please reactivate your plan to access your remaining credits, yet the answer came through. The second question at about 09:55 asked Pilot to add the 2 Tone TPE mat to the inventory list without pushing it to a store. Pilot answered that Doba has no standalone inventory list it can write to and offered a bookmark or its own memory, although the catalogue does have Add to Inventory List behind the trial. The counter then read 28 credits left. Time: about 5 minutes from the start to a first list with supplier prices, shipping and stock through Pilot (09:45 to about 09:52); the web catalogue alone never showed a price. Plans: On doba.com/pricing, in USD, with Monthly, Quarterly (5% off) and Annually (15% off) tabs; with Quarterly selected the prices per month are: Limited $28.67 (Save $3.96), 1 store, 30 one-click listings, an inventory list of 20 and 100 AI Tool Hub credits, Subscribe Now with no trial; Basic $57.00 (Save $8.97), 2 stores, 250 listings, an inventory list of 600, 450 product downloads a month (not included in the trial), 30 auto-listings and 300 AI Tool Hub credits, with a 7-day Trial for US$ 0.99; Standard $142.67 (Save $21.96, Best Choice) with a 5-day Trial for US$ 0.99; Enterprise only monthly or annual. The fees page says that when the trial ends Doba charges the full subscription fee of the chosen plan. Prices, stock and warehouses in the catalogue, the research filters, Add to Inventory List, one-click listing, downloads and the store link all sit behind a paid plan or trial. Checkout: Add to Inventory List opened Start Your $0.99 Trial Now for Basic, billed quarterly, with a 7-day trial; payment by Paypal, Google Pay or card; Basic-Quarterly: Auto-renews at US$170.99/quarter after trial, Auto-renews via saved payment, Cancel anytime to stop future charges, and a box to agree to the Fees and Cancellation Policy. Nothing was filled in and the window was closed. Three months at $57.00 is $171.00, one cent more than the window. Cancelling: no paid plan was active and the Pilot is US$ 0 without renewal, so there was nothing to cancel. The cancel route of a paid plan was not seen; the trial window says Cancel anytime. Not tested: linking a store, pushing products, ordering, Add to Inventory List (behind the $0.99 trial), the refund terms, My Doba, the AI Store Builder, Market Scout and Pilot tasks for a store or listings. Clean up: the account and the Pilot chat stay, with 2 credits used and 28 left. The own tabs were closed and Daan's tab was not touched. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: Without a plan the catalogue hides every supplier price, so you cannot judge a product before paying unless you use the Pilot credits. Pilot said Doba has no inventory list it can write to, which contradicts the Add to Inventory List button in the catalogue. Pilot named the supplier Maji Sports while the cards show Sport Pulse. The $0.99 trial turns into US$170.99 a quarter after 7 days unless you cancel.
